name: Thaumaturgy (Path of the Vine of Dionysus) — 2 Intermediate — Enthousiasmos

system.description: The thaumaturge exudes a narcotic pheromone affecting everyone within a 10-foot radius, inducing pleasant hallucinations and rendering targets Submissive twice, Lethargic and Witless. Affected victims may spend a temporary Willpower Trait to shrug off the effect for one turn before sliding back under. This power lasts one scene. Kindred who begin this path automatically lose one permanent Willpower Trait as they become addicted to its hedonistic pleasures. This path retests with the Occult Ability.
system.discipline: Thaumaturgy (Path of the Vine of Dionysus)
